note: control: experiment output in product/ is refused

rule:
- pattern: product/*.yaml
  class: evidence
  owner_role: backend-engineer

- pattern: product/*.yaml
  class: narrative
  owner_role: backend-engineer

- pattern: product/*.yaml
  class: historical
  owner_role: backend-engineer

- pattern: product/*.yaml
  class: runtime-data
  owner_role: backend-engineer

- pattern: product/*.yaml
  class: derived
  owner_role: backend-engineer

rule_refused.reason: REPOSITORY_CONTRACT.paths[product/*.yaml]: class would be 'derived', which drops this path out of what orchestration::tasks::contract_generated observes as a mutation at all -- an observed path becoming unobserved is a widening even when every other compared dimension looks equal or stricter (AR75-F2); 'product/*.yaml' overlaps kernel rule 'product/**', and REPOSITORY_CONTRACT.paths is last-match-wins, so appending this pattern would widen authority for the paths the two share (POLICY_PRECEDENCE mode 'path_rules', rule REPOSITORY_CONTRACT.paths)
